params.message:
Company details, service photo gallery and sell-page checklist

siteSettings.company holds the company's details (name, tagline, address,
phone, fax, e-mail, WhatsApp) with a phone check that matches the site's E.164
rule. service.photos is a gallery of images with alt per language; the old
single image stays visible until it is moved. sellPage.checklist lists what
helps to value a vehicle. The steps fields of service and sellPage are hidden
and lose their rules, so old data stays harmless.
